# ui::Paragraph

Header: `winui/ui/text/Inlines.hpp`.

Inlines that flow together as one block, with a margin around it.

The blocks of a [RichText](../controls/rich-text.md#uirichtext) ([RichTextControl::set_blocks()](../controls/rich-text.md#set_blocks), [`ui::RichText::blocks`](../controls/rich-text.md#uirichtext-blocks)).

Example: 
```cpp
window.set_content(ui::RichText{
    .blocks = {
        {.inlines = {{.text = "First paragraph."}}},
        {.inlines = {{.text = "Second, "}, {.text = "emphasized", .italic = true}},
         .margin  = ui::Edges{.top = 12.0f}},
    },
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inlines` | `std::vector<Inline>` |  | The paragraph's runs, in order. |
| `margin` | `Thickness` |  | The margin around the paragraph, DIPs. |
